short_description: Global Time Echoes: Distance-Structured Correlations in GNSS Clocks. Multi-center analysis of 62.7M station-pair measurements across CODE, IGS, and ESA (2023-2025). Version 0.28 update.
long_description:
Phase-coherent spectral analysis of 62.7 million station-pair measurements from 364 GNSS stations (2023-2025) reveals systematic distance-structured correlations in clock networks, following an exponential decay with a Temporal Topology correlation length of 3,330-4,549 km and consistent goodness-of-fit across three distinct analysis-center solutions on largely shared raw inputs (CODE, IGS Combined, ESA Final; R2 = 0.920-0.970).

Website: https://mlsmawfield.com/tep/gnss-i/
